title: US EPA AQS Alameda County PM2.5 Forecasting Benchmark — 2025
description: A first real official-source HeatAQ Nexus experiment using an immutable US EPA Air Quality System snapshot. The benchmark selects a monitoring station deterministically by temporal continuity and evaluates transparent baseline and statistical forecasting models.
limitations: Monitoring-site measurements are not equivalent to population exposure.
The selected station represents one monitoring location, not an entire county.
Instrument, method, POC and sampling-duration changes can affect comparability.
The station is selected for temporal continuity, not for geographic representativeness.
This experiment is research software output, not an official warning or medical product.
